sbom_and_signature_artifacts.observed: All three probes returned 'not found'. There is no candidate SBOM artifact, and the cosign .sig/.sbom tags for the superseded candidate's API image digest are still absent, so the signing pipeline has never published an artifact for either candidate.

hosted_release_admission_configuration.command:
gh variable list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --env <dev|staging|production> --json name
gh variable list --repo alfloop-dev/odayplus --json name
hosted_release_admission_configuration.observed: The dev environment defines 38 variables, and neither ODP_RELEASE_LEASE_STATE_URI nor ODP_RELEASE_LEASE_PUBLIC_KEY is among them. The staging and production environments define both. Repository scope returned [], so nothing supplies them as a fallback. The Runtime Release admission job requires RELEASE_LEASE_STATE_URI to match ^gs://[^/]+/.+ and exits 1 otherwise, so a dev release cannot be admitted even with a valid lease document.

blockers.message: No container image is tagged for the candidate SHA in any of the eleven probed repositories; the candidate has no immutable digest to bind.
No Runtime Release run is bound to the candidate SHA, and the workflow is workflow_dispatch-only at this SHA.
Cosign is unavailable in this environment and no candidate signature artifact exists in the configured registry.
No candidate-bound SBOM OCI artifact exists and syft is not installed.
The GitHub dev environment has no release-lease state URI or verification public key, so the hosted Runtime Release admission job cannot pass for environment=dev.

next_action: Configure ODP_RELEASE_LEASE_STATE_URI and ODP_RELEASE_LEASE_PUBLIC_KEY on the dev GitHub environment, then dispatch the single Runtime Release workflow from this exact candidate SHA with a Supervisor-signed lease. The hosted run installs cosign, publishes the candidate SBOM and signatures, and produces the workflow provenance. Only then may this audit be rerun and the manifest moved off release_status='blocked'.
prohibited: No deployment success receipt may be written for this candidate. sbom_refs and signature_refs stay empty and release-receipts-index.json stays at zero receipts until a hosted run produces real artifacts.
